e2e.environment: resident audit Chrome via CDP 9331 (CHESS_PORT overrides; verified on the resident instance); one tab opened and closed; chrome-ensure reuse; no temp Chrome/profile

modeLabel: 2 人 · 人机 / 本地双人 / 联机房间 + AI 补位
designer: 传统棋类（现代规则定型）

online.transport: HTTP/JSON + 700ms polling; server-authoritative; LAN-only by default

features.rooms: 2 seats; room id + single-use invite token + optional password
features.invite: inviteUrl uses the request Host; opens /boardgame/chess-premium/online.html?room=&code=
features.stateSync: stateVersion + lastAction; both seats receive the same 64-square board, SAN history and captured trays
features.aiFill: an empty seat becomes AI; the shared tick loop lets it answer within the same action request
features.reconnect: session token + POST /api/rooms/:id/reconnect; reconnect clears timeout takeover
features.timeoutTakeover: no session request for the configured idle window → server AI plays the seat; reconnect restores it
features.leaderboard: GET /api/leaderboard?game=chess-premium; AI participants included; raw playerId hashed
features.idempotency: per-player idempotencyKey cached before the action guard
features.rematch: host restart creates a new game with colours swapped

evidence.runAll: test-online.js is auto-discovered by node games/tests/run-all.js

shared.sfx: games/shared/sfx.js — index.html and online.html script tag; single shared AudioContext
shared.shuffle: N/A — chess is deterministic; aiMove uses an injectable seeded RNG for tie-breaks
shared.rules: N/A — FIDE rules live in engine.js
shared.leaderboard: shared room server keeps an anonymous in-memory board; no leaderboard copy

realism.rules: FIDE: pawn double-step/en passant/promotion; knight/bishop/rook/queen/king; castling rights and through-check; check/checkmate/stalemate; threefold repetition; 50-move; insufficient material; FEN
